policy: Only CC0 assets, each checked on its original source page. Nothing is fetched at runtime; every file below is served locally from this folder.
original: Game design, rules, scoring, rivals, cups, locker items and simulation (src/features/games/rim-rush).

Players: chunky stylised athletes built from Three.js primitives (lathe torso, capsules, spheres) with an inverted-hull ink outline, painted tank-top jerseys, and two-bone IK posing; no external character models.

Ball, rim, net, backboards, stanchions, end nets, instanced 3D crowds (shader-animated), layered city skyline, clouds, gym bleachers and scoreboard, boardwalk props, arena bowl and LED ribbon, palms, lighthouse and skies (procedural Three.js geometry and canvas textures).
Shot and jump whooshes, power-up chimes, crowd murmur and win/loss stings (WebAudio synthesis).
cover.png: rendered from the game itself (Night Arena), no external artwork.
